description: Two filters whose frequency response morphs continuously from a steep low pass to a high pass, each with its own cutoff, resonance and shape.

params.text: How much the MOD jack moves the first filter's cutoff. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the MOD jack moves the second filter's cutoff. With nothing patched into MOD this knob is a fine tune instead.
Morphs the first filter's response from a twenty-four decibel low pass through a twelve decibel low pass and a band pass to a high pass.
Morphs the second filter's response from a twenty-four decibel low pass through a twelve decibel low pass and a band pass to a high pass.
Sets how the two filters are used: up filters the two inputs separately, middle drives their modulation in opposite directions, down filters IN 1 alone and uses IN 2 to place it across the outputs.

inputs.text: Audio into the second filter, or the stereo position when the switch is down.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
